doc: Normative message-by-message vectors for the minimal engine (conformance/sessions/minimal-engine.md). Each session starts from a fresh engine. Every implementation must produce exactly `expect` (compared as JSON values) for each `send`. {{core.fingerprint}} stands for the generated core contract fingerprint.

sessions.name: every built-in capability, success and failure
uncertain, cancelled and failed outcomes stay distinct
stale results, browser moves and unknown input change nothing but the log
a pre-1.1 kernel is refused and the engine stays inert
a different core contract is refused
an unsupported protocol revision is refused
only the last twenty log entries are kept
